mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees with overcast skies over the Military Ridge State Trail and a Waning Gibbous moon in the sky. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City Hall is preparing for the 2027 Spring Election, and candidate packets are now available at the Clerk's Office. Also, please note that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15, and payments can be made online or via the 24/7 drop boxes at City Center.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Later, you can check out ART House 360 for their Thursday night festivities, followed by Hop Haus Trivia on Thursday.
In their recent report covering November 1st through the 15th, the Verona Police Department noted they were kept busy with several calls, including an O W I arrest.
Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your favorite treats.
